row.proto: int *Game_SaveData_SerialiseContainer_2(SaveDataContainer *self, int *result, void *stream, void *a4, uint64_t groups, void *a6)
row.notes: named from its log messages (channel SaveDataMemory). Inline-encoding twin of Game_SaveData_SerialiseContainer, and the one the profile save uses (Game_SaveData_SerialiseTimed 0x14365850c when bag == 0: the .data1 profile save 0x150b16391 passes r8 = 0 and a stream in r9). Streams straight to the stream (vt+0x48 write): an entry count, uid, version, the own data, then 'containers': key, bag type id, codec header (0x14568e060 vt+0x18 = 1), the count of registered children in groups, and per child its name, the type id and a recursive call. It never reads retain_unknown (+0x100/+0x108) or the retained map (+0x190, count +0x1c8): no instruction in 0x143651030-0x143651e43 touches those offsets, so retained bags are not written to the profile save. Callers: census steam 0x3651030.
